about.heading: About
paragraphs: I’m a computer science student at Stanford University concentrating in artificial intelligence. I’m interested in how AI systems move from technical capability to useful, responsible adoption.

My work spans AI policy research, social-impact consulting, and applied data tools — from studying adoption barriers across Mexico’s key industries to improving school transportation and financial planning.
